story: Stage 4 of the Ethias-Tour de Wallonie 2026 featured an early breakaway of 8 riders who were caught before the final of the stage. With 8 km to go, Sheehan launched a solo attack, followed shortly by Pithie. In the final kilometer, Sheehan seemed set to win, but De Lie overtook him in a powerful sprint in the last 10 meters, claiming the stage win. Sheehan became the new race leader.
